WITH cd AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'M'
      AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
),
d AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
),
st AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s_store_sk, s_state
    FROM store
    WHERE s_state IN ('TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN')
),
fact AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        item.i_item_id AS i_item_id,
        st.s_state AS s_state,
        COUNT(store_sales.ss_quantity) AS cnt_ss_quantity,
        SUM(store_sales.ss_quantity) AS sum_ss_quantity,
        COUNT(store_sales.ss_list_price) AS cnt_ss_list_price,
        SUM(store_sales.ss_list_price) AS sum_ss_list_price,
        COUNT(store_sales.ss_coupon_amt) AS cnt_ss_coupon_amt,
        SUM(store_sales.ss_coupon_amt) AS sum_ss_coupon_amt,
        COUNT(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS cnt_ss_sales_price,
        SUM(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sum_ss_sales_price
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN cd ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN d ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN st ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY item.i_item_id, st.s_state
)
SELECT
    i_item_id,
    s_state,
    GROUPING(s_state) AS g_state,
    SUM(sum_ss_quantity)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(cnt_ss_quantity), 0)::numeric AS agg1,
    SUM(sum_ss_list_price)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(cnt_ss_list_price), 0)::numeric AS agg2,
    SUM(sum_ss_coupon_amt)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(cnt_ss_coupon_amt), 0)::numeric AS agg3,
    SUM(sum_ss_sales_price)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(cnt_ss_sales_price), 0)::numeric AS agg4
FROM fact
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_item_id, s_state)
ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state
LIMIT 100
